task_title: Fix production Floor 2 AI hunt progression

plan_review.notes: Alt A attribution/spawn fix rejected by constraints and probe: all observed family deaths were correctly player-attributed; authored spawn weights unchanged. Alt B separate selector module partially adopted through explicit isolated hunt-state helpers/reset lifecycle, without replacing the existing BT objective contract. Alt C exploration bias partially adopted by reusing door-aware A*, reachable interior cells, dwell/suppression, and deterministic patrol rotation. Added feasibility bound (1/6 family weight, theoretical 42.9 target spawns/min vs 20 required), monotonic roster commitment with deterministic no-progress deferral/revisit, suppression advances reachable patrol points instead of dropping the family, den-unlock-keyed boss filtering everywhere, crash-safe progression telemetry, den-egress assertions, short determinism coverage, and a diagnostic exact-run gate. Follow-up gpt-5.4 red-team considered Alt D, a cached per-tile territory ownership mask, and Alt E, dominant-family fill plus overlap glyph. The chosen family-band display remains clearer, but now uses a cached 4-pixels-per-tile overlay texture with explicit discovery and boss-defeat invalidation, derives integration boundaries from the production quest target, orders bands by family index, covers both radar and fullscreen rendering, guarantees one pixel per family for the production four-family maximum, and separates target-5 versus target-12 proof runs. divergence=minor; no new architecture or ADR warranted.
